North Reading.note: Town center. OSM 42.57509,-71.07867; Wikidata 42.575,-71.07917; about 45 m apart. New Orange Line terminus (Max, November 8, invented).

Market St.note: MarketStreet Lynnfield shopping center, 600 Market St, off I-95/Route 128. The two points are 2 m apart, so one likely copies the other: treated as one source, unverified. New Orange Line loop stop (Max, November 8, invented).
